main_text.l: PECCATA ET POENÆ PECCATORUM in æquilibrio.

l.i: Vt truculenta metit sæua mors omnia falce!Vt magnas strages cedit, & interimit!Nimirum, cum PECCATI mensura repleta est,Accelerat flagrans vindicis ira Dei.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a balance suspended in the sky above a landscape with a castle, and skeletons holding scythes and hourglasses. The title's "Peccatorum" is split across the line as "PECCA-/torum". The verse line "Nimirum, cum PECCATI" has small capitals for PECCATI. The catchword "Quemad-" is at lower right and is cut off by the edge of the printed word.
